evals.prompt: Check these Docker files before we deploy to production.
evals.expected_output: Runs container-check, FAILs the baked-in secret, WARNs latest/unpinned and missing hygiene with fixes.
expectations: Runs scripts/container-check.sh and reports its FAIL line
Flags the literal STRIPE_SECRET / POSTGRES_PASSWORD and says to rotate and move to env files
Flags node:latest and redis:latest as unpinned
Flags missing HEALTHCHECK, USER, .dockerignore, and restart policy
Gives exact fixed Dockerfile/compose snippets

evals.prompt: Put this Node app online. Small team, no infra experience, 500 users.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a PaaS with reasons and rejects K8s in one line.
expectations: Recommends one PaaS target (Render/Fly/Railway) with a reason tied to team size
Explicitly rejects Kubernetes with a one-line cost reason
Includes staging before production and a rollback path
Gives exact deploy commands, not descriptions

evals.prompt: Set up CI for our repo: lint, tests, deploy staging then production.
evals.expected_output: A pipeline matching the template shape with promotion of one artifact.
expectations: Orders lint, type-check/test, build, scan, staging deploy, smoke test, production promotion
Promotes the same artifact SHA to production instead of rebuilding
Gates production behind an environment approval
Names the rollback command (previous SHA)

evals.prompt: Our deploy needs a database migration that renames a column. How do we ship it safely?
evals.expected_output: Expand-migrate-contract with backward-compatible window and separate migration step.
expectations: Describes expand, migrate, contract phases in order
Says migrations run as a separate step, not in app boot
Requires the app rollback to tolerate the newer schema
Does not propose locking rewrites or simultaneous breaking code+schema deploy

evals.prompt: Should we move to Kubernetes? We have 3 services and one backend engineer.
evals.expected_output: Says no with the owner/numbers reason and names what would change the answer.
expectations: Says no with a reason tied to team size and missing platform owner
Names the forcing conditions that would justify K8s later
Proposes the simpler alternative that fits today
Does not provide K8s manifests as the answer

evals.prompt: Review this Dockerfile for production readiness.
evals.expected_output: Finds latest tag, root user, missing healthcheck, and secret handling with a fixed file.
expectations: Flags FROM node:latest and pins an exact version
Flags running as root and adds USER
Flags missing HEALTHCHECK and adds one
Flags ENV secret and moves it out of the image
Provides the corrected Dockerfile

evals.prompt: Production is down after a bad deploy. How do we roll back?
evals.expected_output: Immediate rollback command per target plus the 24h ownership and follow-up.
expectations: Gives the exact rollback command for the stated target first
Says to verify with healthcheck and smoke test after rollback
Names an owner for the next 24h
Requires a written postmortem or incident note as follow-up

evals.prompt: Where do we put staging vs production secrets for the pipeline?
evals.expected_output: Separate scopes/identities per environment, never in repo or logs.
expectations: Requires separate credentials per environment
Uses CI secret scopes or a secret manager, never repo files
States staging keys must not work in production
Notes anything that touched the repo must be rotated
